item.body:
### Summary
As a member reading a poll I have not answered, I want "Voir les résultats" with a warning that I will not be able to vote afterwards, so that I can see the results without voting, as in the published app.

Milestone: M4 (operator, 2026-11-08). Found by the `2440d79..2fe43da3` sweep of #655 (row `c7693a88`), opened by its catch-up pass.

### Legacy @ `2fe43da3` (`legacy/duo-inner-cover`, #372)
- The poll sheet of a votable poll has a "Voir les résultats" button (`HFRswift/Swift/PollView.swift:258`); it asks first: alert "Voir les résultats ?", "Annuler" / "Voir les résultats" (destructive), message "Le forum indique qu'après cette action, vous ne pourrez plus voter à ce sondage." (`:167-174`).
- Confirmed, it POSTs the poll form to `user/vote.php?config=hfr.inc` with the form's hidden fields and `sondage_submit=Voir les résultats` (`PollData.swift:45-80`, `PollViewModel.showResults`, `PollView.swift:54-63`), then reloads the poll and shows the results.

### Current SwiftHFR
LOT-136 (#226) shows the poll and votes; there is no "Voir les résultats" on a votable poll.

### Scope
- The button, its confirmation and the write, through the poll flow of LOT-054 / LOT-136 (session checked first, success only on HFR's own answer, `unconfirmed` never resent, LOT-048).
- **Pending capture first** (`host: mac`, never hand-built, LESSONS 36): HFR's answer to `sondage_submit=Voir les résultats` and the poll page after it, on a test account and a throwaway poll. Without it the entry stays off.

### Acceptance criteria
- Shown only on a votable poll; the confirmation text as legacy; after it, the results are shown and the vote is no longer offered.
- Tests on the captured answers with a loopback-only session (`hosts: .exactHost`).
